import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
a = df[df.account_id=='CZ4NH6K']
before = a[(a.date>='2025-10-06')&(a.date<='2025-10-12')]
after = a[(a.date>='2025-10-13')&(a.date<='2025-10-19')]
gb = before.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).unblended_cost.sum()/7
ga = after.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).unblended_cost.sum()/7
cmp = pd.concat([gb.rename('before'), ga.rename('after')], axis=1).fillna(0)
cmp['delta']=cmp.after-cmp.before
print(cmp.sort_values('delta', ascending=False).head(15).to_string())
print(cmp.sort_values('delta').head(5).to_string())

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv', parse_dates=['date'])
a = df[(df.account_id=='CZ4NH6K')&(df.instance_family=='HRNHGYQxfj')]
print(a.pivot_table(index='date', columns=['cloud_service','application'], values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').tail(15).to_string())
sub = a[a.date>='2025-10-06']
print(sub[['date','price','num_instances','unblended_cost']].to_string())
